title: Kinilaw
description: Kinilaw is a dish from Philippines prepared with tilapia, red onion, serrano pepper, coconut vinegar. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Food-safety adaptation: fish is heat-cooked before vinegar dressing; traditional kinilaw commonly uses raw fish.

steps.instruction: Poach fish pieces until the center reaches at least 63°C or flakes opaque; cool rapidly before combining with the vinegar-and-citrus dressing.
Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 25 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
